01

“and believes in the best”

An explanation transmitted from Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 92:6).

01
Explanation from Ibn ʿAbbās 01

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Sulayman ibn Hayyan narrated to us, from Dawud ibn Abi Hind, from ʿIkrima, from Ibn ʿAbbas:
and believes in the best [al-Layl: 6], he said: “He says: he believes in the replacement (al-khalaf, i.e., God’s recompense).”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
وَصَدَّقَ بِالْحُسْنَى [الليل: 6] قَالَ: «يَقُولُ صَدَّقَ بِالْخَلَفِ»

02

“and what will his wealth avail him when he falls”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 92:11).

02
Explanation from Mujāhid 02

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
and what will his wealth avail him when he falls [al-Layl: 11], meaning: “when he dies.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
وَمَا يُغْنِي عَنْهُ مَالُهُ إِذَا تَرَدَّى [الليل: 11] ، يَعْنِي: «إِذَا مَاتَ»
Edition record 373867 · p. 734Link to report ↗
03

“a Fire blazing”

An explanation transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 92:14).

03
Explanation from Mujāhid 03

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Warqa’ narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid:
a Fire blazing [al-Layl: 14], he says: “it flares up.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: نا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: نا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ:
نَارًا تَلَظَّى [الليل: 14] يَقُولُ: «تَوَهَّجُ»

04

“who denied and turned away”

An explanation transmitted from Abū Umāma (Q 92:16).

04
Explanation from Abū Umāma 04

Abū Umāma

English
Transmission wording
Abd al-Rahman informed us, he said: Ibrahim narrated to us, he said: Adam narrated to us, he said: Abu Fadala narrated to us, from Luqman ibn ʿAmir, from Abu Umama, regarding His saying:
who denied and turned away [al-Layl: 16], he says: “He denied what Muhammad (ﷺ) brought and turned away from it.”
العربية
الإسناد
أنبأ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ: ثنا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، قَالَ: ثنا آدَمُ، قَالَ: ثنا أَبُو فَضَالَةَ، عَنْ لُقْمَانَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، فِي قَوْلِهِ:
الَّذِي كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّى [الليل: 16] يَقُولُ: «كَذَّبَ بِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ مُحَمَّدٌ ﷺ وَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُ»
